description: Migration creates tenant-distributed `list_views` table (tenant, view_id, list_key, name, owner_user_id, visibility check private|shared, settings jsonb, schema_version, timestamps) with composite PK and FKs to tenants/users.
Indexes: (tenant, list_key, visibility) and unique (tenant, list_key, owner_user_id, lower(name)).
Register `list_views` in packages/db tenantTableMetadata.ts and server/migrations/utils/tenantDb.cjs.
Add `list_view:share` and `list_view:manage` MSP permissions to the permission catalog with default grants (share: Admin/Manager/Dispatcher; manage: Admin).
`ListViewSettings` envelope and `ListViewAdapter` contract types in packages/types.
List-key adapter registry that validates list_key and resolves the list's read permission and settings schema server-side.
ListView model (tenantDb-scoped) with visibility-aware query: shared OR owned by session user.
`listListViews(listKey)` returns caller's private + all shared views with owner name, isOwner, canEdit, isMyDefault; gated on list read permission.
`getListView(viewId)` returns shared or owned views; private-of-other and missing both return the same not-found error.
`createListView` validates name (trimmed, 1-100, unique per owner/list) and settings via adapter schema; `shared` requires list_view:share.
`updateListView` patches name/visibility/settings; owner or list_view:manage (shared only); switching to shared requires list_view:share.
`deleteListView` deletes a view (owner or list_view:manage for shared) and clears any `listViews.default.<list_key>` preferences pointing at it.
`setMyDefaultListView(listKey, viewId|null)` stores the default in user_preferences for the session user only, requiring the view be visible to the caller.
User hard-delete path deletes the user's private views and reassigns their shared views to the acting admin.
DataTable supports controlled `columnSizing`/`onColumnSizingChange`, keeping localStorage fallback when uncontrolled.
DataTable supports controlled `columnVisibility` (hidden columns excluded before auto-fit).
DataTable supports controlled `columnOrder`.
`useListViews` hook: loads views, resolves active view from `?view=` → user default → baseline on first load.
`useListViews` apply: adapter.sanitize then adapter.apply, resets to page 1, writes `?view=<id>` to the URL; toast lists dropped stale references.
`useListViews` dirty tracking via adapter.differs, save-changes, save-as-new, discard (re-apply stored).
Inaccessible or missing `?view=` id falls back to baseline with a toast and removes the param.
Adapter `migrate` is applied on read when stored schema_version is older than the adapter's current version.
`ListViewPicker` trigger shows active view name or 'Default view' plus dirty dot.
Picker dropdown lists Default view, My views, Shared views (alphabetical, shared rows show owner), default star, and a search box when >8 views.
Picker row menu: Manage, Set/Clear my default, Copy link, Delete (items hidden when not permitted).
Picker footer: Save changes to <name> (enabled only when dirty and editable), Save as new view…, Discard changes.
Save/Manage dialog (custom Dialog, sticky footer) with Name and Private/Shared visibility; Shared disabled with hint when lacking list_view:share; inline duplicate-name error.
Delete confirmation dialog; deleting the active view reverts the list to baseline.
All picker/dialog strings in `common` namespace `listViews.*` across all locale files incl. xx/yy; all interactive elements have kebab-case ids.
Tickets adapter built on ticketViewSettings helpers, capturing filters incl. board scope (excluding searchQuery), sort, column visibility/order, density, page size, column sizing.
Tickets sanitize drops references to deleted boards, statuses, priorities, categories, tags, users, teams, clients, contacts.
Tickets: applying a view with board scope navigates to that board tab; baseline remains board/tenant default resolution.
Tickets: ListViewPicker rendered in TicketingDashboard toolbar beside TicketViewMenu; board/tenant default save/reset unchanged.
Tickets: `?view=` coexists with existing URL filter params (explicit filter params present = no user-default auto-apply).
Projects: consolidate ProjectListFilters + sort + page size + columns into a typed live-state object consumable by the adapter.
Projects adapter (capture/apply/sanitize/differs) and ListViewPicker on the Projects list.
Clients: consolidate status/type/lifecycle/tag filters, search-excluded, sort, page size, columns into typed live state.
Clients adapter and ListViewPicker on the Clients list (table mode).
Contacts: consolidate status/tags filters, sort, page size, columns into typed live state.
Contacts adapter and ListViewPicker on the Contacts list.
Assets: consolidate status/type/client/agent/RMM filters, sort, visibleColumnIds, page size into typed live state.
Assets adapter and ListViewPicker on the Assets list.
